abstract: Run public LLM benchmarks with Hugging Face Lighteval: pinned install and extras, the Inspect-backed eval command, vLLM, LiteLLM and Accelerate backends, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, task strings and few-shot, reasoning-tag handling, results and per-sample details, custom tasks, troubleshooting and updating. References split by install, backends, tasks and results, troubleshooting and updating.
